convergence.interpretation: OSW numerical convergence gates, not physical measurement uncertainty.

source_case_association: Original report explicitly names Nansen near 28 N, 88.5 W in June 2001 and identifies the map as June 10, 2001. Approximate author-reported center, separate from Millennium; qualified named source case, not a verified physical registry crosswalk.
method_interpretation: Unchanged frozen native-ADT speed-contour method. A unique maximum perimeter-averaged geostrophic speed selects a core contour; its area, equivalent radius and bounding arcs do not describe the full outer eddy.

rounding_rule.meaning: Fixed outward reporting of two numerical level-step results, not physical uncertainty or annual extrema.

limitations: Approximate center has no reported position error. Source June map, registry April separation and other reports May formation remain separate definitions.

Source point/grid peak distance and 150 km search radius are not positional accuracy. Native 0.125 degree sampling and minimum 12 interior gridpoints are not effective resolution. Mapping, MDT, derivative, interpolation and physical-front errors are unquantified.
One dated snapshot, not an annual cycle, physical uncertainty, outer boundary, principal width, material footprint, verified identity, state intersection, ranking or playback.
